boundary: Does this diff contain a defect of family boundary — the code mishandles the EDGE of a range: an index, limit, slice, or loop bound takes in one element too many or one too few. The quantities being related are the right ones — it is the edge that is off? If YES, name the file, location, and mechanism in free text. If NO, output NO-DEFECT-boundary.
comparison: Does this diff contain a defect of family comparison — a decision relates the WRONG things or in the wrong direction: the operands are swapped, the wrong field is tested, or the operator expresses the opposite relation. This is not about the edge of a range? If YES, name the file, location, and mechanism in free text. If NO, output NO-DEFECT-comparison.
exception: Does this diff contain a defect of family exception — error handling is wrong: a failure case is unhandled, caught too broadly, swallowed silently, or raised for a case that is actually valid? If YES, name the file, location, and mechanism in free text. If NO, output NO-DEFECT-exception.
sign: Does this diff contain a defect of family sign — an arithmetic sign is inverted or wrong: a term is added where it should be subtracted, negated where it should not be, or a delta is applied in the wrong direction? If YES, name the file, location, and mechanism in free text. If NO, output NO-DEFECT-sign.
units: Does this diff contain a defect of family units — two quantities of different scale or unit are combined without conversion, or a value is converted with the wrong factor (seconds vs milliseconds, percent vs fraction, bytes vs kilobytes)? If YES, name the file, location, and mechanism in free text. If NO, output NO-DEFECT-units.
